chunks.heading: Yedekleme
chunks.content: Her gece belge klasörü, Markdown önbelleği ve SQLite veritabanı birlikte yedeklenir. Geri yükleme öncesinde servis durdurulur.

chunks.heading: Erişim
chunks.content: Özel kurulumda uygulama portu internete açılmaz. İstemciler Tailscale ağı üzerinden Bearer token ile MCP sunucusuna bağlanır.

chunks.heading: Leave policy
chunks.content: Employees request annual leave at least five business days before the planned absence. Managers respond within two business days.

chunks.heading: Equipment
chunks.content: Company laptops must use full disk encryption and install security updates within seven days of release.

chunks.heading: Recovery
chunks.content: If the Markdown cache is lost, rebuild it from the original documents, which remain the authoritative source of data.

chunks.heading: Search limits
chunks.content: Retrieval returns only ranked chunks. Character and estimated token budgets stop the response before the complete document is exposed.
